The Temporal Nexus

A multi-dimensional view of change ringing. Nodes cluster mathematically based on shared history.

The base layer forms a geographical map of the UK. Methods, ringers, and performances naturally gravitate toward the locations where they are most active.

Click any node to fly to it and view its narrative.

✨ Click any legend item below to isolate its nodes!

Positions are a force layout, not a map projection: distance between nodes reflects the layout’s convergence, not geography or similarity.

Built from data/change-ringing.db by the scripts in scripts/; the SQL behind each page is in queries/, read at build time rather than copied, so the recorded queries are the ones that ran.
